{{Quote|Who but the Sith would think of bolting armor onto a rancor? It makes about as much sense as a chocolate teapot.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], on the Coloi|<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coloi''', also known as the '''Coloi Rancor''', was a type of [[mutant]] [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]]. Over a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Fornayh planned to use the creature to overthrow the [[Sith Empire (disambiguation)|Sith Empire]] of his time. To this end, he began developing the Coloi through the means of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], using a [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. His first step in modifying the rancor was to improve its intelligence. He then gave it lighter bones and large wings, so that it could fly. Afterward, he replaced the skin with black metallic plating that could serve as [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. All the changes that he made were genetic, so that more Coloii could be bred, but by the time Fornayh had perfected the creature, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] was close to [[Death/Legends|death]], so he placed it in stasis in his fortress. He had planned to teach the creature to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weapons, but as he no longer had time to do this, he set up flash-teaching facilities in his fortress, to instruct the Coloi template.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a Coloi was transported to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. During a firefight between some [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and a group of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and [[Security Officer|Naboo Security officers]], a stray [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot struck the creature's cage and allowed it to escape. The Coloi then went on a rampage and caused many [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of damage.<ref name="Kinect Star Wars" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Fornayh's spirit was re-awakened when a [[Griffon's Wings|ship]] crashed on Yorgraxx, and he re-animated his Coloi. However, it was killed by a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members who had entered Fornayh's fortress and confronted him.

==Behind the scenes==
The Coloi was created by [[Robert Wiese]] and first appeared in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Shadows in the Force]]''. It later featured in the [[2012]] video game ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', as a playable-character in the game's "Rancor Rampage" feature.
